title: Designing the Physical World with AI

reader_summary.headline: AI helps design complex hardware like circuit boards and construction projects faster.
reader_summary.overview: AI tools can now design physical hardware by using code generation and simulation. This approach solves the lack of specific training data for physical tasks. The goal is to make building large projects easier and more efficient for everyone.

key_points.text: AI acts like a compiler that gives models hints to write code instead of drawing circuits.
key_points.evidence_quote: We basically built a compiler that gives a model enough hints that it feels like it's writing a Python program instead of designing a circuit board.

key_points.text: Construction projects take years due to slow workflows, but AI can explore thousands of design options instantly.
key_points.evidence_quote: In construction and manufacturing, timeline still stretched into years, shaped by fragmented workflows, fixed incentives, and systems that resist change.

key_points.text: Society needs to create more data because AI currently lacks enough information to fully automate physical tasks.
key_points.evidence_quote: The last frontier standing is we don't have enough data. The data is the thing that we need to generate as a society if we want to be automated by AI.

key_points.text: The team consists mostly of mechanical, electrical, civil engineers who are easier to teach AI tools than software engineers.
key_points.evidence_quote: most of our team is actually not software engineers. Like we're mostly multi-disciplinary, mechanical, electrical, civil, lots of simulation controls.

key_points.text: AI can fix designs to be easier to build by checking many rules and changing the plan until it works.
key_points.evidence_quote: Claude doesn't care if you bash it and say, yes, like this is good but make it more manufacturerable, make it more manufacturerable.
